name: Audio Leveler
author: G-Hancox
description: A companion to FPP's Normalize (10.4+): shows each song's loudness, peaks and clipping, sets Background levels for ambiance, levels new uploads automatically, offers a limiter for songs Normalize leaves short, fixes MP3s that play 25 ms late, and tidies Title/Artist for FPP and FM RDS. On FPP 10.0-10.3 it levels files itself, with backups. Songs and video soundtracks; runs only on this device.

privacy.summary: Runs on this device only. Levels songs through FPP's Normalize (10.4+) or by rewriting them (older FPP, or limiter by choice), with backups.

collects.what: Backup copies of the songs and videos you level, so they can be restored (kept on uninstall)
Loudness measurements, fix choices, song info, EQ settings and presets, leveling history and a log

systemChanges.what: Sets per-song volume through FPP's Normalize on FPP 10.4+ (files unchanged), for the songs and videos you level or new uploads if switched on.
Rewrites a song only without Normalize (10.0-10.3), for the limiter or compression (backed up), or to fix an MP3's timing tag or Title/Artist.
Audio EQ set to Live: switches FPP's audio to Advanced with its own EQ on your sound card; switching it out puts it all back (reboot).
Play through the show makes a temporary playlist, AudioLeveler-Preview, for the song being played; it's removed when the song stops.
